Worriors,
this update includes a few minor fixes.

notes.title: SpeedPads
notes.notes:
Worriors.

This update includes a first look at SpeedPads which catapult the player forward.
You might often find a PowerUp on the SpeedPad to make it worth the risk....

There are some issues with being catapulted into geometry, let's see if you can find them all and report them to the Discord at https://wrgm.es/discord

Happy shooting.

notes.title: Explosive update!
notes.notes:
- Explosive crates deal damage to surrounding obstacles / enemies
- Controller vibration adjustments

notes.title: Bossy bossfights
notes.notes:
After some trouble with uploading new builds things should be rosy now.
The boss should be much more of a challenge and if you have a strong blaster upgrade, it will go through enemies until it's energy is exhausted.
Notice PowerUps now being jumpy a bit after you trash those enemies.

Anyway, hope you're having fun and as always - please join the Discord at https://wrgm.es/discord and leave some feedback, I'm really looking forward to that.
Cheers.

notes.title: Bouncy PowerUps and actually bossy Bossfight
notes.notes:
Just a few tweaks and fixes including PowerUps now bouncing of the floor a little when destroying enemies, strong shots going through enemies until their damage value is at zero and bosses actually being a little harder to fight.

Have fun and as always I'd love your feedback on my Discord at https://wrgm.es/discord

Cheers Worriors.

notes.title: SteamDeck / Proton compatibility
notes.notes:
The game should now run on SteamDeck without any changes to properties.
If it doesn't, please enable Settings > Compatibility > Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool and set it to "Proton Experimental".
